text: You see Jeremiah, a messenger for the Children.
source_text: You see Jeremiah, a messenger for the Children.

text: You see a Child. He looks pensive.
source_text: You see a Child. He looks pensive.

text: Excuse me, brother. You startled me. How may I serve the Master?
source_text: Excuse me, brother. You startled me. How may I serve the Master?

text: Quip!
source_text: Quip!

text: What are you doing?
source_text: What are you doing?

text: Ah, yes, a super mutant in training. I will return to my tasks.
source_text: Ah, yes, a super mutant in training. I will return to my tasks.

text: If you do not know, it is none of your concern. If you are inquiring about something you should not know, then I will have to report you to our supervisors. You should know better.
source_text:
If you do not know, it is none of your concern. If you are inquiring
 about something you should not know, then I will have to report you to our
 supervisors. You should know better.

text: I am a person of high importance.
source_text: I am a person of high importance.

text: I'm sorry to have bothered you.
source_text: I'm sorry to have bothered you.

text: I am new here.
source_text: I am new here.

text: Who the hell are you to be asking me questions?! You're lucky I don't report you to the holy flame!!
source_text:
Who the hell are you to be asking me questions?! You're lucky I don't
 report you to the holy flame!!

text: Transferring the reports, of course.
source_text: Transferring the reports, of course.

text: Reports of what? If I may ask.
source_text: Reports of what? If I may ask.

text: And a mighty fine job you're doing.
source_text: And a mighty fine job you're doing.

text: That is all. Thank you.
source_text: That is all. Thank you.

text: Very well, then. Peace be with you.
source_text: Very well, then. Peace be with you.

text: I apologize. How may I be of service?
source_text: I apologize. How may I be of service?

text: What is it you are doing?
source_text: What is it you are doing?

text: You can start by answering my question.
source_text: You can start by answering my question.

text: You can die!
source_text: You can die!

text: Guards!!!
source_text: Guards!!!

text: It is obvious you do not belong here. Who are you?
source_text: It is obvious you do not belong here. Who are you?

text: I am actually a Vault Dweller and would like to speak to the Master.
source_text: I am actually a Vault Dweller and would like to speak to the Master.

text: Um... Dorpheus... hmm... Morpheus sent me.
source_text: Um... Dorpheus... hmm... Morpheus sent me.

text: I am Loki. An initiate from the south.
source_text: I am Loki. An initiate from the south.

text: No, I don't belong here. But I know where this bullet belongs... in your head.
source_text:
No, I don't belong here. But I know where this bullet belongs... in
 your head.

text: I transfer the human purity reports for the surrounding areas. But you should know this. [looking suspicious] Who are you?
source_text:
I transfer the human purity reports for the surrounding areas. But
 you should know this. [looking suspicious] Who are you?

text: I was sent here by Morpheus with a message for the Master.
source_text: I was sent here by Morpheus with a message for the Master.

text: It is none of your business who I am... just answer my questions!
source_text: It is none of your business who I am... just answer my questions!

text: You are not to know who I am, it is the wish of the Master.
source_text: You are not to know who I am, it is the wish of the Master.

text: You dare question who I am? Fool, I should strike you down where you stand.
source_text:
You dare question who I am? Fool, I should strike you down where you
 stand.

text: That's rather odd... I've never heard of you.
source_text: That's rather odd... I've never heard of you.

text: I was sent here by Morpheus with a message for the Master.
source_text: I was sent here by Morpheus with a message for the Master.

text: I am of the High Order. Only the Master and Morpheus know of me in order to ensure my safety on the outside. But I have been called back by order of the Master.
source_text:
I am of the High Order. Only the Master and Morpheus know of me in
 order to ensure my safety on the outside. But I have been called back by
 order of the Master.

text: Please forgive me. I apologize for questioning you. Please carry on about your business, and if I can be of any service let me know.
source_text:
Please forgive me. I apologize for questioning you. Please carry on
 about your business, and if I can be of any service let me know.

text: I do not know who you are, and you do not belong here. Guards!!!
source_text: I do not know who you are, and you do not belong here. Guards!!!

text: Who are you and what are you doing down here?
source_text: Who are you and what are you doing down here?

text: I am a worshiper and I am lost.
source_text: I am a worshiper and I am lost.

text: Morpheus sent me with a message for the Master.
source_text: Morpheus sent me with a message for the Master.

text: Looking for a lonely soul to send to heaven.
source_text: Looking for a lonely soul to send to heaven.

text: Urk!
source_text: Urk!

text: You are not allowed in this area. Only Servitors and higher allowed down here. Return to the Cathedral proper.
source_text:
You are not allowed in this area. Only Servitors and higher allowed
 down here. Return to the Cathedral proper.

text: I apologize for any trouble I have caused.
source_text: I apologize for any trouble I have caused.

text: May I ask you some questions before I leave?
source_text: May I ask you some questions before I leave?

text: OK, but not before I split your head open.
source_text: OK, but not before I split your head open.

text: Morpheus would not send a slag like you on such a mission. Guards!!
source_text: Morpheus would not send a slag like you on such a mission. Guards!!

text: You idiot! You are not allowed in this area. Return to the Cathedral proper at once!
source_text:
You idiot! You are not allowed in this area. Return to the Cathedral
 proper at once!

text: Akay.
source_text: Akay.

text: Hunh.
source_text: Hunh.

text: Nah.
source_text: Nah.

text: I transfer records for the Master. That is all you need to know, my child. Now, you must leave.
source_text:
I transfer records for the Master. That is all you need to know, my
 child. Now, you must leave.

text: I will leave now.
source_text: I will leave now.

text: I just wish to ask you a few more questions.
source_text: I just wish to ask you a few more questions.

text: I'll leave. I'll leave. But not until I blow your brains out.
source_text: I'll leave. I'll leave. But not until I blow your brains out.

text: How did you get in here?! What are you doing sneaking around?
source_text: How did you get in here?! What are you doing sneaking around?

text: I just wish to ask you a few questions.
source_text: I just wish to ask you a few questions.

text: No, you may not ask me any questions. Now leave.
source_text: No, you may not ask me any questions. Now leave.

text: Stop! You have no business being here!
source_text: Stop! You have no business being here!

text: Duh?
source_text: Duh?

text: Sorry. I'm lost. I'll leave now.
source_text: Sorry. I'm lost. I'll leave now.

text: But I do have business here. Morpheus sent me on a mission for the Master.
source_text:
But I do have business here. Morpheus sent me on a mission for the
 Master.

text: I followed a suspicious looking character down here. Have you seen him?
source_text:
I followed a suspicious looking character down here. Have you seen
 him?

text: No. Killing is my business and business is good.
source_text: No. Killing is my business and business is good.

text: No, I have not seen anyone. What did he look like?
source_text: No, I have not seen anyone. What did he look like?

text: Doesn't matter. I think he got away.
source_text: Doesn't matter. I think he got away.

text: It was a short little green man.
source_text: It was a short little green man.

text: He was about your height but was wearing a leather jacket... What do you have on under those robes?
source_text:
He was about your height but was wearing a leather jacket... What
 do you have on under those robes?

text: He looked just like you, shit-for-brains!
source_text: He looked just like you, shit-for-brains!

text: Um... I... I... You don't actually think it's m... me?  How ridiculous. I've never!
source_text:
Um... I... I... You don't actually think it's m... me?  How ridiculous.
 I've never!

text: Ok. I'll be leaving then, but let me know if you see anything...
source_text: Ok. I'll be leaving then, but let me know if you see anything...

text: Yes! I do think it was you! Get down on the ground and spread 'em!
source_text: Yes! I do think it was you! Get down on the ground and spread 'em!

text: No, I don't believe it was you but may I ask you some questions?
source_text: No, I don't believe it was you but may I ask you some questions?

text: Yes, my brother. How may I be of service?
source_text: Yes, my brother. How may I be of service?

text: Yes, my sister. How may I be of service?
source_text: Yes, my sister. How may I be of service?

text: What is it that you do here, brother?
source_text: What is it that you do here, brother?

text: Just serve the Master. That's all I ask. Brother.
source_text: Just serve the Master. That's all I ask. Brother.

text: Sorry, wrong guy. All you guys look the same in these robes.
source_text: Sorry, wrong guy. All you guys look the same in these robes.

text: You can serve me by dying, you whacked out bastard!
source_text: You can serve me by dying, you whacked out bastard!

text: I transfer the human purity reports for the surrounding areas.
source_text: I transfer the human purity reports for the surrounding areas.

text: That is all. Thank you.
source_text: That is all. Thank you.

text: I would like to ask you a few more questions, brother.
source_text: I would like to ask you a few more questions, brother.

text: Yes, and a very important job it is. And do you understand the importance of your duties to the Master and all of us?
source_text:
Yes, and a very important job it is. And do you understand the
 importance of your duties to the Master and all of us?

text: Why, yes. I am the one who brings the Master the news of new, untainted humans untouched by radiation. I was the one who brought the Master the final news of a possible Lost Vault. It may still have pure-straing humans in it.
source_text:
Why, yes. I am the one who brings the Master the news of new,
 untainted humans untouched by radiation. I was the one who brought the
 Master the final news of a possible Lost Vault. It may still have pure-straing
 humans in it.

text: Yes, my brother. You do understand. Thank you. That is all.
source_text: Yes, my brother. You do understand. Thank you. That is all.

text: I would like to ask you a few other questions.
source_text: I would like to ask you a few other questions.

text: You wouldn't know a pure-strain human if he was standing right in front of you. Idiot.
source_text:
You wouldn't know a pure-strain human if he was standing right in
 front of you. Idiot.

text: You wouldn't know a pure-strain human if she was standing right in front of you. Idiot.
source_text:
You wouldn't know a pure-strain human if she was standing right in
 front of you. Idiot.

text: You act very strangely. I do not believe that you are who you say you are. Guards!
source_text:
You act very strangely. I do not believe that you are who you say you
 are. Guards!

text: You ask too many questions.  I do not believe that you are who you say you are. Guards!
source_text:
You ask too many questions.  I do not believe that you are who you
 say you are. Guards!

text: Hey! I told you were not allowed down here! Guards!
source_text: Hey! I told you were not allowed down here! Guards!

text: You ask too many questions. Who are you?
source_text: You ask too many questions. Who are you?

text: Excuse me, sister. You startled me. How may I serve the Master?
source_text: Excuse me, sister. You startled me. How may I serve the Master?
